summary.headline: TD Power Systems Q1 FY27 standalone total income rose 74% to INR6.3 billion; PAT up 81% to INR853 million; FY27 guidance revised to INR2,600 crores.
summary.overview: Standalone total income reached INR6.3 billion (up 74% YoY) with EBITDA margin of 19.34% versus 18.7% a year earlier, and PAT of INR853 million (up 81%). Order inflow was INR7.34 billion (up 87% QoQ as stated), with 93% from direct and deemed exports, and the manufacturing order book stood at INR22.08 billion. Management revised FY27 revenue guidance to INR2,600 crores with a small chance of exceeding it, and outlined capacity of about INR22 billion for FY28 plus debottlenecking to around INR32 billion for ~INR50 crores capex. Large-generator opportunity and FY29-30 capacity plans (INR40 billion+) were left for an announcement expected in August/next call.

segments.name: Generator and motor manufacturing
segments.commentary: Order book of INR19.29 billion, the bulk of the manufacturing order book. Current business is generators below 100 MW.

segments.name: Railways
segments.commentary: Order book of INR2.11 billion. No fresh railway orders being taken; sustainability to be reviewed at end of this year, with capacity to move to generators and motors after the Indian railway contract completes.

segments.name: Spares and aftermarket
segments.commentary: Order book of INR0.22 billion. Service business remains about 5-6% of overall sales, growing in line with the business.

segments.name: Turkey business
segments.commentary: Order book of INR0.46 billion; about EUR3-3.5 million of orders to execute this year, with no major pipeline for next year. Facility is being kept as a service backup for Europe.

segments.name: Hydro refurbishment
segments.commentary: Several hydro refurbishment orders won and already in Q1 order book; management expects this to be one of TDPS's highest hydro years, with more jobs in Q2 and Q3 pipeline. Not pursuing global expansion for now.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue guidance revised to INR2,600 crores, with a small chance of exceeding it.
Order inflow expected at roughly INR700 crores per quarter, about INR2,800 crores-plus for the full year.

Sufficient capacity for FY28 of about INR22 billion, plus debottlenecking (about INR500 million investment per one statement; about INR100 crores per analyst recap) to reach around INR32 billion; management said this is not a hard ceiling.
FY27 capex stated at about INR50 crores.
Gross contribution margin guidance (approx. plus/minus 1%) maintained; EBITDA guidance of 18-19% referenced by analysts, not explicitly re-stated by management.
Capacity plans for FY29-FY30 to reach INR40 billion-plus to be detailed in next earnings call (~3 months); large-generator opportunity announcement expected in August.
capex_capacity: Current capacity sufficient for FY28 at around INR22 billion; debottlenecking investment of around INR500 million (stated) to lift output toward INR32 billion for FY28.
Analyst recap of INR50 crores capex for FY27 and debottlenecking to ~INR3,200 crores; management confirmed the figure as approximate, plus or minus.
Further capacity additions for generators below 100 MW planned; details to be shared next call after assessing products and capacities.
Capacity to reach INR40 billion-plus targeted for FY29-FY30; specific year not committed.
Large-generator (above 100 MW) opportunity under negotiation; management said close to signing agreements. Such generators take 18-20 months to build.
demand_pricing: Management describes market as very buoyant across segments (AI data centres, grid stabilisation, renewables-linked demand), with shortages of gas turbines, gas engines, transformers and generators.
Gas engines and gas turbines: large-volume orders and forecasts show strong growth.
Steam turbine market growing about 10-12% in captive, biomass and waste-heat recovery.
Domestic India demand described as subdued, around 10-12% growth; export share of orders dominant.
Price variation clauses in customer contracts have been implemented where applicable; management declined to split margin drivers between pricing, cost, mix and FX.
Customer advances received from some customers; management declined to quantify.

qa_highlights.question: Can revenue exceed INR3,000 crores with current base and no new growth capex?
qa_highlights.answer: Management pointed to capacity of about INR32 billion next year with debottlenecking, and said FY29-30 additions would take capacity beyond INR40 billion; details due next call.

qa_highlights.question: Order inflow and capex phasing?
qa_highlights.answer: Expected about INR700 crores per quarter and about INR2,800 crores-plus for the year; debottlenecking capex ongoing with INR50 crores for FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Does guidance include large turbine generators?
qa_highlights.answer: No; large generators take 18-20 months to build, so none expected within six months.

qa_highlights.question: Execution or supply-chain delays affecting orders?
qa_highlights.answer: No disruption to order inflow; products shipped from factory gate, customers taking delivery, though commissioning may be delayed by customer execution.

qa_highlights.question: Service revenue contribution and scale-up?
qa_highlights.answer: Service is about 5-6% of sales and growing in line with the business; generators need little service in their first 10 years.

qa_highlights.question: Working capital and receivables (about INR785 crores) versus cash of INR240 crores; QIP/fundraise rationale?
qa_highlights.answer: Payment terms are fixed with customers and cannot be altered significantly; management declined to discuss the fundraise before a board meeting on Friday.

qa_highlights.question: Volume vs realisation going forward for generator units?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said growth will come from both units and realisation; larger generators will raise MW per unit; no FY30 unit guidance given.

risks_watch: Large-generator (above 100 MW) entry: no details on market size, capex, or timing; announcement promised in August.
Management declined to quantify several items: market share, TAM for sub-100 MW and 50-100 MW ranges, customer advance levels, and margin driver breakup.
Receivables of about INR785 crores and working capital intensity; pending fundraise (QIP) details due after board meeting.
Execution delays at data-centre customers could slow commissioning even though orders hold.
Railway order book (INR2.11 billion) with no fresh orders; sustainability review at year-end.
Turkey facility a cost-bearing service backup with minimal next-year business; potential US tariff exposure cited in media, not yet assessed by management.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand and FY27 guidance, but evasive on specifics: repeatedly deferred questions on FY29-30 capacity, large-generator details, margin drivers, fundraise and TAM, citing an upcoming announcement.

financial_highlights.metric: Standalone EBITDA margin (incl. other income, excl. exceptional and treasury income)

key_quotes: We are always in very, very close contact with all our customers since there's huge amounts of co-dependency that we have with each other.
At the moment, whatever guidance's that I have provided to the market are guidance's that we will be able to achieve.

Our OEM customers have taken significant amounts of non -refundable advances from the people who want to buy their equipment and that is the reason why we have confidence, and they have confidence that the demand will be there in the years ahead.
We need another 3 months' time to finalize our plans.

I'm not going to be able to talk about any fundraise issues. We have issued a notification to the exchange that we'll be having a Board meeting on Friday and I cannot discuss anything before the Board meeting takes place on Friday.

adds.what: Debottlenecking to lift output toward INR32 billion for FY28 (~INR500 million stated; ~INR50 crore FY27 capex per management, approximate)
Generator capacity to reach INR40 billion-plus for FY29-FY30 (year not committed)

growth.why: FY27 revenue guided to INR2,600 crore (a raised figure, small chance of beating it) backed by a INR22.08 billion manufacturing order book and INR7.34 billion Q1 order inflow, with ~INR700 crore per quarter expected; FY28 capacity of ~INR22 billion plus debottlenecking to ~INR32 billion is only partly specified, and the INR40 billion-plus FY29-30 capacity has no committed year.
